# Hi, I'm Wlademir. {.hero-title}

I'm a data scientist and R/Shiny developer with a PhD in Finance. I build data applications that make it to production and write here about what I learn on the way: applied analyses with code you can run, the engineering around data products, and notes on building a career in data.

[Read the articles](articles.qmd){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg role="button"}

## A free data science handbook

I wrote [O Manual do Cientista de Dados](https://wrprates.github.io/o-manual-do-cientista-de-dados/), an open handbook in Portuguese on the practical side of data science. A good place to start is the chapter on [hypothesis testing](https://wrprates.github.io/o-manual-do-cientista-de-dados/teste_de_hipoteses.html). The source is on [GitHub](https://github.com/wrprates/o-manual-do-cientista-de-dados).

## Elsewhere

I share shorter notes and videos on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/wlademir-ribeiro-prates/), [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/datamundo.cientista/) and [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@wlademir). Code lives on [GitHub](https://github.com/wrprates/).
